answer: Each agent must escrow a bond before joining the market, and its identity earns access only by completing randomly assigned jobs whose results are checked against hidden test cases and peer audits. A challenger can submit a conflicting result; if adjudication finds fraud, the agent loses its bond and its endorsers lose part of theirs. Creating many identities therefore requires many funded bonds, while fake work risks correlated slashing: the attacker pays real capital for every Sybil, even when violet claims drift across the ocean under a cedar.
